title: Content Engine Automation Pipeline
description: Timeline-first pipeline: a recording is a list of scenes; each scene is a set of typed event tracks (input / camera / reveal / attention) on an absolute time axis. The recorder schedules events by `at` (seconds from scene start), drives the cursor with humanized motion (config: record.cursor), shapes durations with a seeded RNG (config: record.humanize), and pans the crop with per-segment ease (config: each camera keyframe's `ease`).

name.description: Pipeline identifier, used in output folder/manifest naming.

viewport.description: Desktop viewport the app is rendered at. The app is NOT made responsive; scenes crop sub-regions of this canvas.

timelineOffsetMs.description: Constant offset added when slicing the raw video; compensates encoder lead-in.

settleMs.description: Pause after each scene's setup phase, before its region is measured.

humanize.description: Organic timing — wraps every `wait`/`ms` value with ±jitter randomness, adds pre-action pauses before cursor-bearing events. Driven by a seeded RNG so runs are reproducible.

seed.description: PRNG seed. Change to roll a different performance.

jitter.description: Fractional jitter applied to numeric `ms` values, e.g. 0.15 = ±15%.

preActionPause.description: Randomized hesitation before cursor-bearing events (click, rightClick, fill, hover). Range [min, max] ms.

cursor.description: Cursor personality — bezier travel with overshoot and hover hesitation, all driven by these parameters.

duration.description: Travel duration in ms (number or [min,max] for random sampling).

overshoot.description: Fractional overshoot past the target (0 = none). The cursor aims slightly past, then settles back.

hesitation.description: Hover hesitation in ms before the click fires (number or [min,max]).

curvature.description: Bezier control-point offset perpendicular to the chord (0 = straight line).

resolution.description: Final clip resolution. Default is a 9:16 vertical frame for Reels / TikTok.

fitMode.description: cover = scale-to-fill + center-crop; contain = scale-to-fit + pad.

scenes.description: Ordered scenes. Recorded in one continuous session, then sliced + cropped per scene.

id.description: Unique scene id; becomes the clip filename (output/scenes/<id>.mp4).

target.description: Which part of the desktop canvas this scene captures.

durationSec.description: Scene clip length in seconds. The scheduler holds the recording until this elapses, even if all events finished sooner.

holdAfterSec.description: Optional static hold AFTER `durationSec`, letting the final state breathe before the next scene.

setup.description: Timeline of events run BEFORE the scene clock starts (e.g. open a pane, pre-inject state). Same event shape as tracks.input; `at` is relative to setup start.

tracks.description: Per-scene event tracks. Times (`at`) are absolute scene-relative seconds. All tracks are flattened, sorted by `at`, and dispatched by a single scheduler.

input.description: User-driven events: clicks, fills, key presses, scroll, drag, eval, injectFlow. Cursor-bearing types route through the humanized mouse driver.

camera.description: Camera keyframes — the crop window's centre at time `at`. Camera lerps between successive keyframes with per-keyframe `ease`.

reveal.description: Staggered reveal effects (node appear / port glow / edge animate / param highlight). Track is reserved — runtime not yet implemented.

attention.description: Attention choreography (linger, pulse, inspect). Track is reserved — runtime not yet implemented.

target.description: Region of the rendered app to crop for this scene. Provide exactly one of: selector, pane, paneIndex, region, fullViewport.

selector.description: CSS selector; the element's bounding box is captured.

paneIndex.description: Zero-based index of a [data-panel] element in document order.

region.description: Fixed pixel rectangle within the viewport.

aspect.description: Optional 'W:H' ratio (e.g. '9:16'). Carves the largest sub-rectangle of that aspect from the resolved box.

padding.description: Shrink (positive) or expand (negative) the resolved box. Number = all sides, or per-side object.

inputEvent.description: User-driven event on the input track. Cursor-bearing types (click, rightClick, dblclick, hover, fill) route through the humanized mouse driver — `at` is when the gesture STARTS (cursor travel + hesitation + click run forward from there).

type.description: press: keyboard combo (key=e.code, plus shift/ctrl/alt/meta). type: type into the focused element. fill: focus+clear+set an input by selector. click/rightClick/dblclick/hover: target by selector (optional `position` offset, `nth` for which match). wait: pause `ms` ms (rarely needed on a timeline — use `at` instead). waitForSelector: wait for selector state. scroll: wheel by deltaX/deltaY (optionally over selector). drag: press on selector, glide to `to` or `toSelector`, release. eval: run a JS expression. injectFlow: build a node graph via window.__injectFlow from `file` (optionally only the first `nodeCount` nodes).

delay.description: Per-keystroke delay for `type`. Number or [min,max] for random sampling.

position.description: Click point as an offset inside the target element.

nodeCount.description: `injectFlow`: inject only the first N nodes (+ edges among them).

ms.description: For `wait`: pause duration. Number or [min,max] for random sampling.

cameraFollow.description: If true, drop a camera keyframe at this event's target the moment it fires — convenience for 'camera follows the cursor'.

cameraEvent.description: Camera keyframe at `at`. Use `point` for an absolute viewport coord OR `selector` (+ optional `position`) for a DOM-anchored target whose position is resolved at firing time. The crop window's centre passes through these keyframes in order, eased per-segment.

revealEvent.description: (Reserved.) Progressive reveal — stage opacity/scale/glow on a target. Runtime not yet implemented; events parse but are no-ops with a warning.

attentionEvent.description: (Reserved.) Attention choreography — linger / pulse / inspect on a target. Runtime not yet implemented.

ease.description: Easing curve used to arrive AT this keyframe from the previous one.
